records.display_title: feat(guards): add component-props-type guard and fix bare Props types

head_commit.message:
feat(guards): add component-props-type guard and fix bare Props types

- Add `grit/shadcn/component-props-type.grit` (warn): `*Props` types in `.tsx` files must build on
  React/DOM props types (PropsWithChildren, ComponentProps, HTMLAttributes, explicit children,
  PageProps/LayoutProps/RouteContext) instead of a bare object literal.
- Prefer `ComponentProps<typeof ShadcnComponent>` when a shadcn primitive is the root; documented in
  `.agents/rules/shadcn.md`, the guard coverage doc and the grit README.
- Add unit test for the guard and register it in `biome.json`.
- Wrap bare `*Props` types in the notes-app forms with `PropsWithChildren<{...}>`.
